FROM "normalized"."party" R1
 JOIN 
"normalized"."coverage" R2 ON 1 = 1 
 JOIN 
"normalized"."holding" R3 ON (LOWER(CASE     WHEN R3.IS_DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R3.IS_DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND LOWER(CASE     WHEN R2.IS_DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R2.IS_DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND LOWER(CASE     WHEN R1.IS_DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R1.IS_DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND R1.PARTY_ID = CONCAT('PARTY#',R2.PARTY_ID) AND R1.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND R1.IS_DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R2.IS_DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R3.MARKET_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND R3.IS_DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R1.PARTY_ID IS NOT NULL AND R2.HOLDING_ID = R3.HOLDING_ID) 
 LEFT OUTER JOIN 
"normalized"."holding_subaccount" R4 ON (LOWER(CASE     WHEN R4.DELETED = true THEN 'true'
    WHEN R4.DELETED = false THEN 'false'
    ELSE NULL 
END) = 'false' AND R2.HOLDING_ID = CONCAT('PARTY#',R4.HOLDING_ID) AND R4.FUNDNAME IS NOT NULL AND R4.DELETED IS NOT NULL AND R4.SK IS NOT NULL) 
GROUP BY R1.FULL_NAME
ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT(CAST(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(CAST(R3.MARKET_VALUE AS VARCHAR), '^[-+]?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]*$') THEN CAST(CAST(R3.MARKET_VALUE AS VARCHAR) AS DECIMAL(38, 18)) ELSE NULL END AS DECIMAL(38, 18)))),0) DESC NULLS LAST
